title: GPT image 2 used inside Codex for in-workflow asset generation
summary: The video notes that OpenAI's GPT image 2 model can be invoked directly inside Codex to generate game textures, UI elements and other visual assets during a coding session, then refined in the same workflow.

research.notes: GPT image 2 is referenced as an in-Codex tool but no dedicated public release page was retrieved during this pass.
